title: Four process lessons from lane priority-vs-merge-order get a home: record after each round, read merge state when opening, run three lints on markdown, never two lane lints at once
why: Lane priority-vs-merge-order, 04:04 CST Nov 14 (relayed; its own reads, not read by triage): the four lessons were NOT filed anywhere (the lane first wrote "filed" in error). (1) Post the tool-printed review record right after each passing round. (2) Read a PR's merge state when opening it: a dirty PR gets no CI run. (3) Run the STE, cost-pin and glossary lints on every markdown edit before pushing. (4) Never start two lane lints at once in one checkout (git fetch ref locks). Possible overlap by name, unread: record-after-each-round and review-record-before-any-push (1), lane-lint-before-push (3). Each lesson still needs a check or a rule, not prose alone (outcomes-mechanize-rules).
note: Filed 04:04 CST Nov 14 by triage. Unstarted. The coordinator sorts each lesson to an existing step or its own lane. Closed 04:06 CST Nov 14: homes (coordinator's picks, 04:05, fit read by title only): (1) record-after-each-round, (2) new step pr-merge-state-read-at-open, (3) lane-lint-before-push, (4) lane-lint-in-isolated-worktree (partial fit).
